summary: Staff can review mailing-list-only subscribers, and registering an account links matching list signups after email verification without undoing opt-outs.
detailed_changes: Staff get a mailing-list-only subscribers page at /staff/subscribers with search, filters, pagination and audited CSV export (#504).
Newsletter index shows account-holder versus mailing-only confirmed counts (#505).
Signup matching links an existing mailing contact only after email verification or Cloudron SSO, without duplicating contacts or resetting opt-outs (#506, #508).
Members see a one-shot notice when existing subscriptions are matched, with a link to manage preferences (#507).
Account deletion offers Keep my newsletter subscriptions (default on); privacy and rights pages describe the choice (#509).
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff reviewing mailing lists; readers registering or deleting accounts
Public impact: safer signup matching and clearer erasure choices for newsletters
Internal impact: LinkMailingContactService, newsroom:link-mailing-contacts artisan command, mailing_contacts.email_normalized
